traits.name: Evasion
traits.text: When the mithral golem rolls a success on a Reflex save, it gets a critical success instead.

traits.name: Golem Antimagic
traits.text: harmed by cold and water (8d10 (8d10), 2d10 (2d10) from areas and persistent damage); healed by transmutation (area 2d10 (2d10) HP); slowed by electricity.

traits.name: Swift Steps
traits.text: A mithral golem is permanently quickened, and it can use the extra action only to Step or Stride.

traits.name: Vulnerable to Slow
traits.text: A mithral golem is not healed by a slow spell, and such spells affect them normally. A haste spell reverses the effects of a slow spell immediately.

traits.name: Liquefy
traits.text: ⬻ The mithral golem becomes fully liquid and amorphous. It gains immunity to precision damage, but it takes double damage from cold and water magic (see golem antimagic). The only actions it can use while Liquefied are move actions, Spike Storm, and spike Strikes. It can resume its normal form by taking this action again.

traits.name: Spike Storm
traits.text: ⬽ The mithral golem makes a spike Strike against each target within its reach. These attacks count toward the mithral golem's multiple attack penalty, but its multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ fist +31 (agile, magical, reach 15 feet); Damage 3d12+12 (3d12+12) bludgeoning

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ spike +31 (deadly 2d10, magical, reach 30 feet); Damage 3d10+12 (3d10+12) piercing
